RestServiceDefinition.SqlExecute:
select distinct 'AP:' || accessPackagesCatalogs.displayName || '/' || ap.displayName as RoleName, a.ChildRoleName as ChildRoleName, assignedApps.AccessPackageResources_displayName as ChildRoleSystemName
from ( SELECT accesspackagesRoles.id as accessPackageId, displayName AS RoleName, json_extract(value, '$.role.displayName') AS ChildRoleName, json_extract(value, '$.scope.originId') AS originId FROM accesspackagesRoles, json_each(accesspackagesRoles.resourceRoleScopes_json) )a inner join accesspackages ap on a.accessPackageId = ap.id inner join accessPackagesCatalogs on accessPackagesCatalogs.id = ap.catalog_id inner join assignedApps on a.originId = assignedApps.accesspackageResources_originId order by 1,3,2
